title: Tserriednich is revealed as a serial killer
summary: Tserriednich murders and dismembers young women while treating their bodies as material for his collection.

title: Benjamin challenges Tserriednich
summary: Benjamin tells Tserriednich that only one prince will survive the voyage and promises to eliminate him personally.

title: The fourteen princes enter the Succession Contest
summary: The royal heirs gather for the urn ceremony and receive the eggs that will awaken their Guardian Spirit Beasts.
legacyTitles: Appearance of Benjamin Hui Guo Rou

title: The rules of the Succession Contest are read out
summary: Only the children of the king's eight legal wives take part. The contest opens when the Black Whale sounds its departure horn, thirty-five days later, and if any potential heir dies before that first blast the contest is called off. The ritual is presented as the work of the first king of Kakin, modelled on an old poisonous magic — hence the chapter's worm-jar title.

title: Kurapika and Mizaistom trace Beyond's escape plan to Saiyu
summary: Reviewing the footage of Beyond's interrogation, the two read his claim that his goal lies past the Dark Continent and his certainty that the Zodiacs will end up freeing him. They settle on Saiyu — whose Three Monkeys takes sight, hearing and speech — as Pariston's man inside, and plan to take him just before landfall without letting Beyond know.

title: Hisoka and Chrollo begin their death match
summary: At Heaven's Arena, Chrollo reveals a prepared combination of stolen abilities and promises Hisoka certain death.

title: Chrollo kills Hisoka
summary: More than two hundred manipulated puppets overwhelm Hisoka; the final explosions leave him dead beneath the bodies.

title: Hisoka resurrects and changes the hunt
summary: Post-mortem Bungee Gum restarts Hisoka's heart and lungs; he then kills Kortopi and Shalnark and vows to hunt every Spider.

title: The eve festival closes and the ship is opened
summary: On the night before departure Nasubi addresses the crowd gathered at the Kakin port and the Black Whale is opened to its passengers. The five tiers are assigned: Tier 1 to the royal family, the V6 politicians and the industrial dignitaries, Tier 2 to celebrities and the rich, Tiers 3 to 5 to the general passengers. The ship sails under martial law — the Royal Army holds the through-ways between tiers, the monitoring halls and every phone line.

title: Balsamilco sets the soldiers' rules of engagement
summary: Benjamin's military adviser briefs the troops: only Tiers 1 and 2 may serve as hunting ground for the contest. A metal bulkhead closes Tier 2 off from Tier 3 and opens only from the upper side, and only in an emergency.

title: Kurapika and Oito look for a way out of the contest
summary: Kurapika works through evacuation routes and counts what the Woble camp is against: the other princes hold armies, and roughly a hundred and fifty Hunters have been hired across the factions. Oito answers that only the higher-ranked queens may open a line and that the guards hold the phones. Mizaistom calls in with stolen tickets voiding entries and a medical staff too thin for the lower tiers. Oito says she no longer wants to die aboard.

title: Kurapika senses a dark aura around Woble's cradle
summary: As the servants carry the cradle in, Kurapika reads an aura coming off the child — the first sign of the parasitic beast the voyage will later name.

title: Woody is found dead
summary: Woody dies between 12:15 and 12:30, minutes after the Black Whale leaves port, and is found exsanguinated on the bathroom floor of room 1014. Kurapika reaches the bathroom shortly afterwards with Bill, Kurton, Sayird and two more of the detail.
occursAfterTitle: Ship Departs
note: The ship sails at noon and Woody dies between 12:15 and 12:30, so the death belongs to the departure chapter, not to the eve: chapter 358 is before the ship exists as a place, and the on-ship rule in the backfill turns every event under 359 off-ship. Filed at 358 the death was dropped from the ship timeline entirely, and the bathroom-floor spot `localSpotAnchors` reserves for the body could never be reached. `occursAfterTitle` is what keeps it ordered after the departure: the event already held an ordinal from when it sat at 358.2, and curated ordinals are preserved.

title: The inaugural banquet gathers the royal family
summary: The Tier 1 banquet hall receives the court for the first dinner of the crossing: Nasubi on his throne, the five highest princes — Benjamin, Camilla, Zhang Lei, Tserriednich and Tubeppa — Halkenburg, Kacho and Fugetsu, Momoze in a corner with Marayam and their mother Sevanti, and Queen Oito with the child the archive later learns is her nephew. The hall holds through chapters 359 to 362 as the princes leave at staggered intervals: Kacho uses hers to propose an alliance to Fugetsu, Halkenburg crosses to the throne to tell his father he withdraws from the contest, Tserriednich and Tubeppa strike their own alliance, and Nasubi lays down the rules the Guardian Spirit Beasts must obey.
occursAfterTitle: Woody is found dead

title: Four more guards are found exsanguinated
summary: Escorting Oito and the child back from the banquet, Kurapika and his detail come on four more bodyguards dead in a corridor of the royal residential sector, drained of blood exactly as Woody was. Five deaths in an afternoon is what turns an unexplained corpse into the pattern Kurapika reads as parasitic Nen. The four are never named; the next chapter establishes that each of the five was serving a queen other than Oito.
occursAfterTitle: The inaugural banquet gathers the royal family

title: Kurapika interrogates the detail
summary: Gun and Dowsing Chain drawn in room 1014, Kurapika tells the bodyguards and servants what the voyage really is — a succession war — and questions each of them on what they already knew. Two admit they knew and that they are not Woble's men. Oito orders him to shoot them on the spot; he has them tied to chairs instead, and one explains that the five dead guards each served someone else: Oito being the lowest-ranked queen, the other seven placed their own guards around her as informants.
occursAfterTitle: Four more guards are found exsanguinated

title: Sayird is manipulated
summary: Controlled by a parasitic Nen ability, Sayird kills Kurton and attacks Kurapika before being subdued.
note: The interrogation at 360.1 comes first: it gathers the whole detail, Kurton included, and he dies in this event.

title: Vincent attacks room 1014
summary: Sandra dies of the wound he gave her at the end of the previous chapter. Vincent then opens fire on Bill and Kurapika, and poisons himself once they overpower him.

title: Benjamin hears his man out and replaces him
summary: Room 1001 listens in as Vincent is pinned and dies. Benjamin and Balsamilco lose the spy the deployment bought them, and Babimyna is sent to take the post in room 1014 — the man Bill will be told to watch.
occursAfterTitle: Vincent attacks room 1014

title: Camilla resurrects after Musse kills her
summary: Camilla's post-mortem Nen beast kills Musse and uses his life force to restore her body.

title: Zhang Lei and Tubeppa approach room 1014
summary: Benjamin, Zhang Lei and Tubeppa all call room 1014 at once — Zhang Lei from his chair, over a snack. Both of the latter seek information from Kurapika; Zhang Lei receives Oito and Woble at the dining table of his own suite, Sakata on his left and Coventoba on his right, while Tubeppa proposes a truce.

title: The fourteen suites, one by one
summary: The chapter walks every room of the royal residential sector. Marayam eats under three servants and three guards, Biscuit among them; Nipaper, Bladge, Laroc and a fourth guard the archive has not identified hold Momoze's door while she sleeps, Nagmum and Tuffdy off duty in the guards' beds; Fugetsu looks through photographs in bed under two; Kacho takes her meal with Melody in the room; Halkenburg wakes to find his eleven bodyguards unharmed; Salé-salé lies in with two women, three guards and his mother Swinko-swinko; Luzurus talks with his lead Hunter; Tyson plays with a guard under Izunavi's eye; Butch reports to Tubeppa in her office; Theta and Tserriednich work the training floor; Zhang Lei holds his dining table with Oito, the child and a standing Kurapika at the far end; Camilla eats with her mother while Musse sits alone at a desk down the passage; and Balsamilco keeps the telephone by Benjamin's door, Furykov in the room. Kurapika's party then goes home to 1014, where Babimyna has taken Vincent's post. Six decks down, Chrollo sits in Area 37564.
occursAfterTitle: Chrollo orders the hunt for Hisoka

title: Kurapika brings the Woble camp home
summary: Kurapika, Oito and the child leave Zhang Lei's table and return to room 1014, where Babimyna now stands in Vincent's place among the guards already posted there.
occursAfterTitle: The fourteen suites, one by one

title: The princes respond to the Nen stalemate
summary: Tyson promotes her Book, Luzurus sends a guard to learn Nen, and the royal factions adapt to Kurapika's announcement.

title: Chrollo orders the hunt for Hisoka
summary: The Phantom Troupe gathers aboard the Black Whale, accepts Illumi as a member and begins searching the lower tiers for Hisoka.

title: Camilla attacks Benjamin
summary: Camilla shoots at Furykov, Benjamin and Balsamilco before Furykov breaks her arm and arrests her.

title: Momoze is assassinated
summary: Tuffdy strangles Momoze after her Guardian Spirit Beast exhausts her aura and disappears.

title: Emperor Time runs out on Kurapika
summary: Emperor Time has been held for nearly three hours by the time the team reaches Momoze. The count costs Kurapika about 450 days of his life and he collapses from it.
occursAfterTitle: Momoze is assassinated

title: The Nen class is agreed and Tserriednich presses Theta
summary: Momoze's six guards are detained, and Hanzo and Biscuit read the killing as the work of an off-duty guard using a copy of himself. Kurapika sets the first lesson for the next day; most princes agree to send two guards each. In his own quarters Tserriednich asks Theta how long learning Nen actually takes, and the scene closes on blood.
occursAfterTitle: Emperor Time runs out on Kurapika

title: Kurapika wakes from a nine-hour black-out
summary: Bill tells Kurapika he was unconscious for about nine hours and that the others were told he was on a mission. Oito went down at almost the same moment, since she was holding the borrowed ability with him.
occursAfterTitle: Emperor Time runs out on Kurapika

title: The limits of Emperor Time are spelled out
summary: Continuous use of Emperor Time is capped at three hours; past that the user blacks out for three times the time spent — nine hours here — and whoever shares the ability blacks out with him. Kurapika suspects the power of the stolen ability moves the allotted time.
occursAfterTitle: Kurapika wakes from a nine-hour black-out

title: The princes send their guards to the first Nen class
summary: Sixteen guards and servants are sent to room 1014 with orders of their own: Satobi (Luzurus) warns his side that one bodyguard is manipulating everyone, Mushaho (Salé-salé) reads the class as a chance to spy on the other details and open negotiations, Longhi and Maor (Tubeppa) fall back on letters since coded traffic can be intercepted and give themselves two weeks to win Kurapika over, Danjin and Myuhan (Tserriednich) carry a threat to kill them all if they fail to acquire Nen in two weeks, Furykov (Benjamin) is told to catalogue Kurapika's Nen, tics and abilities, Tenftory (Chôrai) is to watch everyone who approaches him and the numbers 1, 4 and 5 above all, Belerainte and Barrigen (Marayam) are to report back in detail, Yuri and Loberry (Kacho) and Ladiolus and Illardia (Fugetsu) come as non-combatant servants sent in place of the bodyguards, and Yuhirai and Shedule (Halkenburg) are to investigate the mark Kurapika spoke of and trade every finding.
occursAfterTitle: The limits of Emperor Time are spelled out
note: The princes' orders contradict one another — spy, recruit, learn, kill — which is why the room holds militiamen, soldiers and servants at once rather than one detail per prince.

title: Kurapika lays down the rules of the Nen class
summary: Facing the assembled guards in room 1014, Kurapika draws a white line nobody is to cross, warns that he will use force without warning if he judges it necessary and that anyone breaking the rule can be excluded, and promises that in two weeks everyone will have Nen even if some learn more slowly than others.
occursAfterTitle: The princes send their guards to the first Nen class
note: Exclusion is the only sanction that bites: given what their princes sent them to do, none of them can afford to be thrown out.

title: Silent Majority possesses Loberry
summary: The hidden assassin uses Loberry as the only witness to the masked doll observing Kurapika's Nen class. The user states the rule of the ability out loud: only two people can see the decorative doll — Loberry, on whom it is fixed, and the user who activated it.
occursAfterTitle: Kurapika lays down the rules of the Nen class

title: Kurapika asks who already knows Nen
summary: Before teaching, Kurapika asks the users among them to raise their hands. Furykov and Belerainte alone answer; Kurapika reads Furykov as an observer sent to grade his teaching, and Belerainte says he is glad to give a frank opinion. The hidden assassin counts four more who keep quiet and reckons nobody but them will notice.
occursAfterTitle: Silent Majority possesses Loberry
note: Six Nen users are in the room by the assassin's count, two declared and four hidden — the assassin among the four.

title: Silent Majority kills Barrigen
summary: Loberry, the only one who can see the masked doll, points at it and panics; the room sees nobody. The doll attacks on the user's order and four conjured tsuchibokko fasten onto Barrigen — the guards see only something white around his neck and try to tear it off. One doll needs 44 seconds to drain a body, the four together barely 11, and Barrigen is dead before anyone can reach him.
occursAfterTitle: Kurapika asks who already knows Nen
note: The murder is committed in front of sixteen witnesses and one Nen teacher, and none of them can see the weapon — that is the point of the ability, and the reason the class turns into an investigation.

title: Silent Majority kills Myuhan
summary: The assassin strikes the moment Myuhan steps into the toilets: he screams, and ten seconds later he is dry. A Nen user among the guards puts three of the dolls down and reports that one is still inside. Kurapika seals the scene — the salon door shut with nobody moving, Bill holding the bedroom door until he arrives — and reads the pattern out loud: the killer only takes people without Nen, the attack is unstoppable in a moment of inattention if you have none, and nobody is at risk while he is present. The user has evidently unlocked their own Nen; the doll has vanished where it cannot have gone, being far too big for the pipes.
note: Kurapika mentions having had a run-in with Myuhan the day before, which places the murder a day after the first Nen class of chapter 369.

title: The class turns on Kurapika and calls for the army
summary: The surviving envoys read the deaths as an extermination: they are being picked off one by one and were lured in with the promise of Nen, which several of them now call a fabrication with no proof behind it. One demands the Royal Army be called and says he knows exactly whose side the magistrate will take. Kurapika's camp cannot allow it — with the court already having every residence searched, calling the army would see the queen, the prince and the detail placed in separate detention — so the class has to be talked into continuing, and the lie kept standing rests on the same guards staying in the room.
occursAfterTitle: Silent Majority kills Myuhan
note: The assassin's leverage is procedural rather than lethal: each killing pushes the class closer to summoning the army, and the army is what would separate Oito and Woble from Kurapika.

title: Hanzo avenges Momoze
summary: Hanzo identifies Tuffdy, obtains his confession in detention and kills him with Hanzo Skill 4.

title: Momoze is laid out in the princes' burial chamber
summary: The king stands over Momoze's open coffin in the funerary hall and is offered condolences. He refuses mourning: his daughter's radiance is only stronger now, she is part of the foundations of Kakin, she is still alive. The panel that pulls back is what settles the room — a round chamber, the fourteen coffins set radially around a central spire, one of them Momoze's.

title: The Phantom Troupe subdues the Buor men
summary: Franklin, Phinks, Feitan and Nobunaga overpower three mafia members and interrogate them about Kakin's underworld.

title: Kurapika sorts the class and reads the beasts
summary: Kurapika explains that a prince's parasitic beast is invisible to anyone who is not a Nen user, while a conjured beast can be seen by user and non-user alike, and he puts forward that a prince withdrawing from the contest would take his beast with him. He splits the participants into three groups and assigns Furykov and Belerainte to check aura flow.

title: The Phantom Troupe divides the search for Hisoka
summary: Chrollo disperses the Spiders across the lower tiers while Shizuku and Bonolenov choose to accompany him.

title: Morena unleashes Contagion
summary: In room 302 on Tier 3, Morena addresses the twenty-three people present — the ones who stayed at her side after she ordered them to kill one another — and thanks them for it. She admits she is young and inexperienced to have taken the head of the clan, says she cares nothing for this world any more than for herself, and that this is exactly why she is destroying it. She then calls them forward one at a time to have their faculties examined: the kiss that carries Contagion. Levels are earned by murder, and the family leaves the room as Nen users pointed at Kakin.

title: The mafia bosses set the Spiders against Heil-Ly
summary: Onior and Brocco decide to let the Phantom Troupe and Heil-Ly weaken each other while their families search for Hisoka.

title: A cutaway of the ship places everyone at ten in the morning
summary: A double-page section of the hull, captioned fourth day of the crossing, 10:00, puts a name to every post that matters below Tier 2. Third-class observation post: Illumi and Kalluto. Ordinary third-class cabins: Cashew. The Level 3 governmental and political zone — the body that enforces political law, the central police, the local section of the Royal Army — holds Mizaistom, Botobai, Piyon, Cluck and Ginta. The special medical zone, central hospital and general laboratory, holds Cheadle, Leorio and Gel. Luini sits in the Ei-I family office. Chrollo, Bonolenov and Shizuku are in the central passage; Feitan at the hangar entrance; Hinrigh in the Xi-Yu office; Machi in the ordinary fifth-class cabins; Franklin in the fifth-class central canteen; and Ken'i Wang, Nobunaga and Phinks in the Cha-R office.
note: This is the only time stamp in the arc attached to a map rather than a scene, and the only page that fixes the Zodiacs, the three mafia offices and the whole Troupe at one hour. It is a snapshot of Day 4 and not a standing state: `shipLocation` in the character files holds each figure's latest known post, which for several of them — Bonolenov in the Tier 1 casino, Phinks in the recycling works, Luini dead in the Cha-R hideout — is a later chapter than this one.

title: Fugetsu emerges alone on Tier 3
summary: An uncontrolled use of Magical Worm takes Fugetsu to Tier 3, where the Hunters place her under Justice protection.

title: Thirty-seven and a half hours out of port
summary: A caption over the sea gives the elapsed time since the ship put out: 37 h 30 min. Against the noon departure of chapter 340 that lands at 01:30 on the third day, in the small hours of the night after the first Nen class. The panels around it are quiet: the galley at work, Oito holding Woble in her room, and the Woble camp taking stock — Hanzo's disappearance inside Marayam's quarters is read as a defensive act of the thirteenth prince's Nen beast, keeping a line open to him is called essential, and the results are to be reported back.

title: Fugetsu's Magical Worm opens
summary: Fugetsu wakes in her bed — the clock beside her reads TUESDAY 01:27 AM, the only weekday the arc ever puts on the page — and a door rises out of her wall: the entrance of the Magic Warm ride she and Kacho played on as small children. It opens onto Kacho's room, where her sister is awake with her phone. Her Guardian Spirit Beast turns out to make passages rather than defend her.
occursAfterTitle: Thirty-seven and a half hours out of port
note: The clock and the chapter's 37 h 30 min caption agree to within three minutes, which fixes both against the noon departure — and makes the sailing day a Sunday, the weekday the banquet hall's Sunday schedule already assumed.

title: Marayam's room is isolated
summary: Marayam's Guardian Spirit Beast moves room 1013 into a protected Nen space that cannot be re-entered from outside.

title: The class catalogues the princes' Guardian Spirit Beasts
summary: The beasts are read one by one. Tyson's sets eye-wogs on the readers of the Book of Tyson, giving them contentment and drawing their aura, with a heavy penalty on breaking the book's taboo. Halkenburg's is a symbiotic enhancer that raises the potential and the aura of the followers it marks — the highest grade of ability on the ship, and the one Benjamin's man Shikaku flags as the real threat. Camilla's, Tubeppa's and Luzurus's are set out in turn.

title: Predator devours Salé-salé's Guardian Spirit Beast
summary: After studying its conditions, Rihan's Predator neutralizes Salé-salé's manipulative Guardian Spirit Beast.

title: Salé-salé is assassinated
summary: Yushohi kills Salé-salé with Stand by Me; the death is concealed and attributed publicly to illness.

title: Mizaistom redistributes the Royal Army
summary: At a conference with Kakin military officials, Mizaistom argues the Tier 3 killings serve the Succession Contest rather than stress, and has the soldiers redistributed so that more stand on the third deck and below.
occursAfterTitle: Fugetsu emerges alone on Tier 3

title: The Cha-R show the Troupe their surveillance
summary: The three Troupe members are taken into the family's headquarters on Tier 5 — the clan emblem framed between two doors, sofas around a low table, a monitor room next door from which the Cha-R record the places that matter to them on the deck, the reception room included. The footage of the theft is played back: the man walks the hangar guard away, moves too much for his face to be readable, tries the back door in his panic, finds it locked and leaves the way he came. There are cameras at the warehouse entrance only, and apart from the family's own comings and goings the tape shows nobody but the three of them. They ask for a list of every non-mafia passenger going back to the previous day, on the reading that the thief came to scout the place first.
occursAfterTitle: Luini empties the Tier 5 warehouse guardpost
note: The Cha-R surveillance is what makes the lower decks legible at all: the Royal Army holds Tiers 1 and 2, and on Tier 5 it is a mafia family that keeps the cameras and the tapes.

title: Luini empties the Tier 5 warehouse guardpost
summary: Nobunaga, Phinks and Feitan come to collect their smuggled weapons and find the warehouse guards gone and a blood trail at the entrance; Luini kills the Cha-R man escorting them and opens a portal above their heads.
occursAfterTitle: Morena unleashes Contagion

title: Halkenburg commits to the Succession Contest
summary: After failing to shoot Nasubi or himself, Halkenburg accepts the fight and awakens his collective Nen ability.

title: Kacho and Fugetsu attempt to escape
summary: The twins leave the Black Whale in a lifeboat, triggering the succession ceremony trap.

title: Kacho dies and Without You awakens
summary: Kacho dies outside the ship and her Guardian Spirit Beast activates in her image.

title: Without You rejoins Fugetsu aboard the Black Whale
summary: The post-mortem Nen construct bearing Kacho's appearance returns through Magical Worm and remains beside Fugetsu.

title: Tserriednich survives Theta's execution attempt
summary: Parallel Future lets Tserriednich foresee the gunshot, evade it and conceal the outcome from his guards.

title: Halkenburg strikes Shikaku
summary: Halkenburg's collective arrow pierces every defence and transfers Sumidori into Shikaku's body.

title: Lynch exposes the false Hisoka
summary: Lynch strikes Bonolenov in disguise and her ability reveals that the man posing as Hisoka is an impostor.

title: Lynch tests Hanal while searching for Hisoka
summary: Lynch strikes Hanal on Tier 3 and Body and Soul confirms that the passer-by is not Hisoka.

title: Bonolenov kills Lynch
summary: Bonolenov neutralizes Zakuro, kills Lynch and impersonates her to keep the Phantom Troupe's deception intact.

title: The Heil-Ly hideout is traced to Tier 2
summary: Hinrigh plants a transmitter beyond the room 3101 trap, allowing the Phantom Troupe to locate Morena's true base.

title: Kacho's posthumous letters are distributed
summary: Fugetsu visits the princes under Justice Ministry escort to deliver the messages prepared by Kacho.

title: Dogman abducts Borksen
summary: Using Halkenburg's funeral procession as cover, Dogman identifies and abducts the Specialist sought by Morena.

title: Chrollo searches the funeral procession
summary: Chrollo uses Love Dial 6700 among Halkenburg's mourners and concludes that the target he needs is on an upper tier.

title: The real Hisoka appears at the Tier 1 casino
summary: Hisoka plays SQ-X while Bonolenov, still disguised as him, spots him and immediately changes form to avoid detection.

title: Halkenburg's body dies
summary: Halkenburg's original body dies while his consciousness continues operating from Balsamilco's body.

title: Chrollo targets the Kakin regalia
summary: Chrollo identifies the three royal treasures as the key to strengthening Skill Hunter before his next fight with Hisoka.

title: The Spiders find the waste route between the tiers
summary: Guided by Tajao through the lower decks, Nobunaga learns that the Heil-Ly hold the waste processing that runs between Tiers 4 and 5 — a way to move as disposal contractors and take targets off the ship one at a time. Elsewhere the Xi-Yu find Lynch Fullbokko with a broken neck, and Hinrigh reads the double deception: someone wearing Hisoka manipulated a woman already manipulated, to put Hisoka where he is not.

title: Morena begins her negotiation game with Borksen
summary: Morena asks Borksen to join Heil-Ly and uses a card game that forces both sides to reveal information and narrow the answer.

title: Morena reveals her goal and origins
summary: The game compels Morena to explain Contagion, her origin as a Kakin “Meat” and her plan to destroy the kingdom and the world.

title: Borksen fulfills a condition of Contagion
summary: Borksen trades a kiss for a recovered response card, unknowingly satisfying one of the conditions of Morena's ability.

title: Benjamin discovers the body swap and his infection
summary: Benjamin realizes that Halkenburg controls Balsamilco and learns that he has been infected with TSK-17.

title: Borksen accepts Morena's offer
summary: Borksen deliberately chooses Yes and joins Heil-Ly, remaining at level zero until Contagion's final condition is met.

title: Three soldiers vanish in room 3101
summary: Soldiers sent into room 3101 on Tier 3 do not come back out. A hidden passage into the neighbouring room marks the place as a Heil-Ly hideout.

title: Benjamin presses the Justice Bureau for martial law
summary: Benjamin calls the disappearances a biological-weapons attack mounted by rival princes and pushes Mizaistom, Botobai and Kaiser to place the government under his command. He has about nine and a half hours before the infection puts him under.
occursAfterTitle: Three soldiers vanish in room 3101

title: Benjamin proclaims martial law
summary: Benjamin orders the capture of the princes and moves his command centre to the Justice Bureau on Tier 2.

title: Oito reveals that the baby is not Woble
summary: Confronted by Kurapika and Bill, Oito admits that the child in room 1014 is her nephew; the real Woble remains missing.

title: Kakin announces the Dark Continent expedition
summary: Nasubi appoints Beyond Netero to lead Kakin toward the Dark Continent, and the V5 orders the Zodiacs to capture him.

title: Beyond surrenders to the Zodiacs
summary: The Zodiacs learn about the Five Threats before Beyond voluntarily places himself in their custody.

title: The V5 brings Kakin into the V6
summary: Beyond challenges the Zodiacs, while the international powers decide to support Kakin and make the Hunters escort him.

title: Leorio and Kurapika are recruited as Zodiacs
summary: Cheadle recruits Leorio for the expedition, and his recommendation brings Kurapika back into contact with the Association.

title: Kurapika identifies Tserriednich as his target
summary: Mizaistom reveals that Tserriednich owns the remaining Scarlet Eyes, giving Kurapika a route into the expedition.

title: Kurapika exposes the risk of a Zodiac mole
summary: Kurapika concludes that Beyond prepared allies inside the Hunter Association, and the Zodiacs organize their expedition roles.

title: Ging reproduces Leorio's Nen technique
summary: Ging defeats Muherr's staged ambush by copying and extending the remote-punch technique that Leorio once used on him.

title: Kurapika recruits guards for the younger princes
summary: Kurapika brings Biscuit, Basho, Izunavi, Hanzo and Melody into the royal bodyguard selection to reach Tserriednich.

title: Chrollo combines Order Stamp and Gallery Fake
summary: Chrollo demonstrates how copied bodies can be turned into puppets while concealing his movements among the audience.

title: Chrollo overwhelms Hisoka with puppets
summary: Dozens of controlled spectators attack Hisoka while Chrollo repeatedly strikes from within the crowd.

title: Hisoka turns severed heads into weapons
summary: Hisoka uses Bungee Gum and Shu to fight through the puppets and briefly injure Chrollo.

title: Chrollo prepares the explosive final assault
summary: Post-mortem Sun and Moon marks preserve copied puppets, allowing Chrollo to assemble an explosive swarm.

title: Kurapika steals Sayird's ability
summary: Kurapika subdues Sayird and uses Steal Chain, revealing the Emperor Time condition needed to control the stolen power.

title: The rules of the Guardian Spirit Beasts emerge
summary: The princes learn that the beasts cannot directly kill one another or another host, while Tserriednich forces Theta to teach him Nen.

title: The princes take stock of their beasts, room by room
summary: The chapter walks the royal residential sector. Luzurus questions three of his Hunters from his armchair, Basho among them, and sets them to watching for other beasts. Tyson takes a head massage and a manicure from her detail while asking Izunavi — Kurapika's own Nen teacher — what her beast looks like, and is pleased to hear fairies. Salé-salé holds a party with his women and shows no interest in either the contest or the thing hovering over him. Theta and Salkov settle in the corridor how much Nen they will let Tserriednich have.
occursAfterTitle: The rules of the Guardian Spirit Beasts emerge

title: Halkenburg's eleven bodyguards collapse
summary: Halkenburg comes back to room 1009 and finds all eleven of his bodyguards unconscious on the floor, with no explanation he can see. It is the first act of his Guardian Spirit Beast, twenty chapters before he awakens Grimmel the Dissonance and learns that the ability runs on the aura of the followers it marks.
occursAfterTitle: The princes take stock of their beasts, room by room

title: Camilla puts the drop-out rule to the king
summary: Zhang Lei opens the chapter learning in the corridor, then in room 1003, that Woble's detail has been all but wiped out, and reads the beasts as the key to it. In the banquet hall Camilla asks her father to confirm that only biological death counts as dropping out of the contest; Benjamin comes up behind her, mocks the question and tells her she is unqualified. Both leave the hall — she frustrated, he furious, with two soldiers behind him.
occursAfterTitle: Halkenburg's eleven bodyguards collapse

title: Balsamilco talks Benjamin down in room 1001
summary: Balsamilco tells Benjamin across the table that every prince carries a Nen beast, and that he cannot see his own. He counsels patience on two counts: moving alone is dangerous while the beasts are invisible to him, and Kurapika's emergency broadcast has made Nen common knowledge in every camp, which costs them the advantage they held.
occursAfterTitle: Camilla puts the drop-out rule to the king

title: Benjamin deploys his soldiers among the princes
summary: After learning the limits of the guardian beasts, Benjamin uses his private army to monitor the other royal factions, in rotating shifts and with orders to report and to shoot in self-defence. The chapter takes the reactions room by room: Zhang Lei with six guards, Camilla with two, promising death to whoever comes in, Tserriednich with Theta and one more guard ignoring the whole thing, and Tubeppa with a single guard, asking after Kurapika.

title: Vincent stabs a servant in room 1014
summary: Oito carries the child while Kurapika and Bill wait for the spy Benjamin has certainly sent. He comes in as Vincent, stabs the servant Sandra at the entrance and calls it self-defence. Kurapika reads it for what it is — the assassination attempt the deployment was cover for — and the room turns on him in the next chapter.
occursAfterTitle: Benjamin deploys his soldiers among the princes

title: Kurapika explains the Guardian Spirit Beasts
summary: Kurapika shares the mechanics of parasitic Nen with rival guards while Oito and Bill search for an insect for Little Eye.

title: The two camps plead before the Supreme Court
summary: A caption dates the session: third day, 10:05 in the morning. Camilla's counsel tells it as self-defence — the second prince was attacked by Musse, a militiaman of the first prince, saw a weapon trained on her, felt herself in danger and opened fire; she then went after Musse and ran into Hyurikofu, another of Benjamin's militiamen, and Vorufu, a guard of the first queen. Her side demands that Benjamin and his militia hand Musse over for attempted murder on the second prince, and charges the first prince with having ordered the killing. Benjamin's side objects: ten rounds fired at an unarmed prince is out of all proportion, and they cover Musse in no way whatsoever. Both camps then demand a search of the other's residence.
note: The court hears the surface version. Chapter 373 has already shown what happened — Musse killed Camilla and her post-mortem beast killed him and rebuilt her — so the self-defence account is true only of the shots she fired after coming back.

title: Cleapatro confines both princes and orders every residence searched
summary: The magistrate puts Benjamin and Camilla under supervised detention in the VIP zone until Musse is caught. Their protection details stay as they are, but every time either prince leaves the zone a supervisor answering to the court goes with them, and rather than search one residence the magistrate asks the Royal Army to search them all. Benjamin's camp takes the ruling as a nuisance rather than a check: Musse's Mimizuku knows everything, detention puts Camilla out of their reach — but whatever she does and wherever she goes, they will know.
legacyTitles: Benjamin and Camilla are placed under judicial surveillance
occursAfterTitle: The two camps plead before the Supreme Court

title: Heil-Ly sabotages the murder investigation
summary: Luini escapes through his spatial ability while Cashew mixes truth and lies to mislead Mizaistom.

title: Theta shoots Tserriednich during Zetsu
summary: Theta uses the disappearance of the guardian beast during training to execute Tserriednich with a shot to the head.

title: Tserriednich understands Parallel Future
summary: Tserriednich determines that Zetsu grants him a ten-second vision whose predicted outcome remains visible to everyone else.

title: Kurapika rapidly awakens the Nen students
summary: Kurapika lends abilities through Stealth Dolphin to open the students' aura nodes while Bill demonstrates Water Divination.

title: Xi-Yu clashes with Heil-Ly on Tier 3
summary: Hinrigh, Lynch and Zakuro confront Heil-Ly members; Hinrigh kills the soldiers who try to expel his team.

title: Hinrigh begins tracking the Heil-Ly routes
summary: Hinrigh turns a camera into a scouting animal while Lynch and Zakuro continue the search for Hisoka.

title: The room 3101 trap claims Tassi
summary: Tassi crosses the threshold, is teleported into the Heil-Ly base and killed so Bille can reach level 21.

title: The Phantom Troupe probes room 3101
summary: Nobunaga, Phinks and Feitan use neighbouring rooms and unwilling test subjects to investigate the Heil-Ly teleportation trap.

title: The future Spiders perform in Meteor City
summary: A young Chrollo organizes a dubbed screening of Power Cleaners with the children who will later form the Phantom Troupe.

title: Sarasa's murder shapes the Phantom Troupe
summary: The children find Sarasa murdered; Chrollo commits to mastering technology and building a group that will hunt her killers.

title: Hinrigh and Nobunaga enter the Heil-Ly hideout
summary: The pair crosses the trapped rooms and confronts Morena's followers before Yokotani expels them through his legal ability.

title: The Phantom Troupe confirms the hideout is on Tier 2
summary: Phinks, Feitan and Nobunaga use Hinrigh's transmitter to establish that Morena's Nen space lies above Tier 3.

title: Longhi offers Kurapika a binding alliance
summary: Longhi reveals Moonlight Act, her connection to Beyond and the plan to identify which prince may be his child.

title: Balsamilco begins the TSK-17 assassination plan
summary: Balsamilco enters the Justice Bureau intending to infect Halkenburg during questioning, as Kacho's letter reveals Unma is Halkenburg's mother.

title: Halkenburg takes Balsamilco's body
summary: Halkenburg fires through the courthouse wall and transfers his consciousness into Balsamilco before his original body succumbs.

title: Kurapika opens the second Nen class
summary: Kurapika expands the lessons, explains how the succession ritual can fail and announces that Woble is not an eligible participant.

title: Beyond meets Judge Cleapatro
summary: Cleapatro visits Beyond in his VVIP cell to review the more than one thousand lawsuits he filed against Kakin.

title: Halkenburg's burial confirms his soul survives
summary: Nasubi observes that Halkenburg's flame is unlit and confirms that his succession rights remain while his soul inhabits another body.

title: Benjamin's soldiers begin their martial-law operations
summary: Kanjidol attacks Luzurus's guards while military teams prepare to force entry into Halkenburg's quarters.

title: Kurapika seeks his friends' help to protect Woble
summary: Kurapika proposes tracing the real Woble and dismantling Beyond's curse, trusting friends on the mainland to protect her.

title: Furykov confronts Beyond about his sacrificial curse
summary: Two months before departure, Furykov analyzes the curse placed on him at birth, determines that the Seed Urn Ceremony assigned it a royal target and confronts Beyond.
legacyTitles: The Seed Urn Ceremony assigns royal targets to Beyond's curses
occursAfterTitle: The fourteen princes enter the Succession Contest

title: Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland
summary: Kurapika and Oito discuss a letter intended for Oito's sister through a delivery service before the declaration of martial law interrupts them.
legacyTitles: Furykov identifies the structure of Beyond's curse

title: The royal camps respond to special martial law
summary: The princes and their guards receive conflicting movement, escort and disarmament orders as Benjamin summons the heirs and tightens control of Tier 1.
occursAfterTitle: Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland

title: Ridge subdues Kanjidol during martial law
summary: After Kanjidol arms part of Luzurus's guard detail, Hunter Ridge defeats, injures and detains him in the royal residential sector.
